extracted.intended_audience: encyclopedia/Factbook editors, country-profile compilers, and data analysts preparing or reviewing country entries
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for composing and populating individual country-profile entries in a Factbook-style reference, specifying what each entry should contain, definitions to use, and methodological cautions (e.g., GDP methodology, demographic metrics, geographic and legal descriptors).

rubrics_metrics.name: Environmental agreements (participation levels)
rubrics_metrics.description: This entry separates country participation in international environmental agreements into two levels - party to and signed but not ratified. Agreements are listed in alphabetical order by the abbreviated form of the full name.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide participation status at two levels (party to; signed but not ratified) and list agreements alphabetically by abbreviation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Environmental agreements (Appendix C contents)
rubrics_metrics.description: Appendix C: Selected International Environmental Agreements includes the name, abbreviation, date opened for signature, date entered into force, objective, and parties by category.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When referencing the appendix, include full metadata for each agreement: name, abbreviation, signature/opening date, entry-into-force date, objective, and categorized parties.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ethnic groups
rubrics_metrics.description: This entry provides an ordered listing of ethnic groups starting with the largest and normally includes the percent of total population.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List ethnic groups in descending size order and include percent of total population where available.

rubrics_metrics.name: Exchange rates
rubrics_metrics.description: This entry provides the official value of a country's monetary unit at a given date or over a given period of time, as expressed in units of local currency per US dollar and as determined by international market forces or official fiat.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Present official exchange rate(s) expressed as local currency per US dollar; indicate date or period and note whether rate is market-determined or official fiat.

rubrics_metrics.name: Executive branch (subfields)
rubrics_metrics.description: This entry includes several subfields. Chief of state includes the name and title of the titular leader. Head of government includes the name and title of the top administrative leader. Cabinet includes the official name for this body and the method for selection of members. Elections includes the nature of election process or accession to power, date of the last election, and date of the next election. Election results includes the percent of vote for each candidate in the last election.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide named officeholders and titles for chief of state and head of government; describe cabinet composition and selection; summarize election process and dates; include vote percents for recent results.

rubrics_metrics.name: Exports (total)
rubrics_metrics.description: This entry provides the total US dollar amount of exports on an f.o.b. (free on board) basis.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report export totals in US dollars on an f.o.b. basis and indicate the reporting period/date.

rubrics_metrics.name: Exports - commodities
rubrics_metrics.description: This entry provides a rank ordering of exported products starting with the most important; it sometimes includes the percent of total dollar value.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Rank exported commodities by value and include percent share of total exports when available.

rubrics_metrics.name: Exports - partners
rubrics_metrics.description: This entry provides a rank ordering of trading partners starting with the most important; it sometimes includes the percent of total dollar value.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Rank export partners by value and include percent share when available.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fiscal year
rubrics_metrics.description: This entry identifies the beginning and ending months for a country's accounting period of 12 months. All yearly references are for the calendar year (CY) unless indicated as a noncalendar fiscal year (FY).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: State fiscal year start and end months; clarify whether data are calendar-year or fiscal-year and note changes that preclude chaining numbers across volumes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Flag description
rubrics_metrics.description: This entry provides a written flag description produced from actual flags or the best information available at the time the entry was written.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Give a textual description of the national flag; note that dependent areas use independent states' flags unless a local flag is officially recognized.

rubrics_metrics.name: Flag graphic
rubrics_metrics.description: Most versions of the Factbook include a color flag at the beginning of the country profile. The flag graphics were produced from actual flags or the best information available at the time of preparation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include a color flag graphic where possible; use official or best-available representation; note exceptions for disputed areas.

rubrics_metrics.name: GDP (definition and reporting)
rubrics_metrics.description: This entry gives the gross domestic product (GDP) or value of all final goods and services produced within a nation in a given year. GDP dollar estimates in the Factbook are derived from purchasing power parity (PPP) calculations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report GDP as value of final goods/services; use PPP-based dollar estimates and note methodological caveats.

rubrics_metrics.name: GDP methodology (PPP emphasis and cautions)
rubrics_metrics.description: GDP dollar estimates for all countries are derived from purchasing power parity (PPP) calculations rather than from conversions at official currency exchange rates. PPP uses standardized international dollar price weights applied to quantities of final goods and services. PPP estimates are more reliable for OECD countries and rougher for developing countries; exchange-rate dollar estimates can differ substantially. Numbers cannot be chained across successive volumes because of changes in dollar measuring rod, data revisions, source changes, and statistical method changes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explain PPP method, its advantages over exchange-rate conversions, reliability differences by country type, and caution users about non-chainability across volumes and potential proportion differences (e.g., defense as percentage of GDP).

rubrics_metrics.name: GDP - composition by sector
rubrics_metrics.description: This entry gives the percentage contribution of agriculture, industry, and services to total GDP.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Present sectoral shares (agriculture, industry, services) as percentages of GDP.

rubrics_metrics.name: GDP - per capita
rubrics_metrics.description: This entry shows GDP on a purchasing power parity basis divided by population as of 1 July for the same year.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Compute and present GDP per capita using PPP dollars and midyear population (1 July).

rubrics_metrics.name: GDP - real growth rate
rubrics_metrics.description: This entry gives GDP growth on an annual basis adjusted for inflation and expressed as a percent.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report annual real GDP growth rate (percent) for the reference year.

rubrics_metrics.name: Geographic coordinates
rubrics_metrics.description: This entry includes rounded latitude and longitude figures for the purpose of finding the approximate geographic center of an entity and is based on the Gazetteer of Conventional Names and other sources.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide rounded lat/long for approximate geographic center; cite Gazetteer and other sources as basis.

rubrics_metrics.name: Geographic names
rubrics_metrics.description: Presented in Appendix F: Cross-Reference List of Geographic Names. Includes alternate names, former names, local names, and regional names referenced to one or more related Factbook entries. Spellings are normally those approved by the US Board on Geographic Names (BGN).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List alternate/former/local names and follow BGN spellings when possible; include parenthetical additional information.

rubrics_metrics.name: Geography (category)
rubrics_metrics.description: This category includes the entries dealing with the natural environment and the effects of human activity.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include environmental and human-impact geographic information relevant to the country profile.

rubrics_metrics.name: Geography - note
rubrics_metrics.description: This entry includes miscellaneous geographic information of significance not included elsewhere.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use this field for notable geographic details that don't fit standard subentries.

rubrics_metrics.name: GNP (definition and usage)
rubrics_metrics.description: Gross national product (GNP) is the value of all final goods and services produced within a nation in a given year, plus income earned by its citizens abroad, minus income earned by foreigners from domestic production. The Factbook uses GDP rather than GNP to measure national production.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Define GNP and clarify that Factbook reporting follows GDP conventions; note contexts where remittances may be important.

rubrics_metrics.name: GWP (gross world product)
rubrics_metrics.description: This entry gives the gross world product (GWP) or aggregate value of all final goods and services produced worldwide in a given year.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When used, report aggregate global output for a given year.

rubrics_metrics.name: Heliports
rubrics_metrics.description: This entry gives the total number of established helicopter takeoff and landing sites (which may or may not have fuel or other services).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide count of heliports; note variability in services available.

rubrics_metrics.name: Highways
rubrics_metrics.description: This entry states the total length of the highway system and the length of the paved and unpaved parts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report total highway kilometers/miles and break out paved vs. unpaved lengths.

rubrics_metrics.name: HIV/AIDS - adult prevalence rate
rubrics_metrics.description: This entry gives an estimate of the percentage of adults (aged 15-49) living with HIV/AIDS. The adult prevalence rate is calculated by dividing the estimated number of adults living with HIV/AIDS at yearend by the total adult population at yearend.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report adult (15-49) prevalence as percent, specify numerator and denominator and reference year.

rubrics_metrics.name: HIV/AIDS - deaths
rubrics_metrics.description: This entry gives an estimate of the number of adults and children who died of AIDS during a given calendar year.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide annual AIDS death estimates and specify the calendar year.

rubrics_metrics.name: HIV/AIDS - people living with HIV/AIDS
rubrics_metrics.description: This entry gives an estimate of all people (adults and children) alive at yearend with HIV infection, whether or not they have developed symptoms of AIDS.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report yearend estimate of people living with HIV (total), indicate whether symptomatic or not is included.

rubrics_metrics.name: Household income or consumption by percentage share
rubrics_metrics.description: Data on household income or consumption come from household surveys, adjusted for household size. Nations use different standards and procedures in collecting and adjusting the data. Surveys based on income will normally show a more unequal distribution than surveys based on consumption.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When presenting income/consumption shares, note survey basis (income vs consumption), adjustment methods, and caution about cross-country comparability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Illicit drugs (categorization and definitions)
rubrics_metrics.description: This entry gives information on the five categories of illicit drugs - narcotics, stimulants, depressants (sedatives), hallucinogens, and cannabis. The entry provides brief definitions/examples for many substances (e.g., cannabis, coca, cocaine, depressants, hallucinogens, heroin, stimulants, etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Classify illicit drugs into the five categories and include brief definitions/examples; distinguish between legal medical drugs and illegal misuse where relevant.

rubrics_metrics.name: Imports (total)
rubrics_metrics.description: This entry provides the total US dollar amount of imports on a c.i.f. (cost, insurance, and freight) or f.o.b. (free on board) basis.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report import totals in US dollars and specify whether values are c.i.f. or f.o.b., and the reporting period.

rubrics_metrics.name: Imports - commodities
rubrics_metrics.description: This entry provides a rank ordering of imported products starting with the most important; it sometimes includes the percent of total dollar value.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Rank imported commodities by value and include percent of total imports when available.

rubrics_metrics.name: Imports - partners
rubrics_metrics.description: This entry provides a rank ordering of trading partners starting with the most important; it sometimes includes the percent of total dollar value.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Rank import partners by value and include percent share when available.

rubrics_metrics.name: Independence
rubrics_metrics.description: For most countries, this entry gives the date that sovereignty was achieved and from which nation, empire, or trusteeship. For other countries, the date may represent a significant nationhood event. Dependent areas include the notation 'none' followed by the nature of their dependency status.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide date and context of independence or equivalent nationhood event; for dependencies, note 'none' plus dependency status and see Terminology note for exceptions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Industrial production growth rate
rubrics_metrics.description: This entry gives the annual percentage increase in industrial production (includes manufacturing, mining, and construction).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report annual percent change in industrial production and define included sectors.

rubrics_metrics.name: Industries (rank ordering)
rubrics_metrics.description: This entry provides a rank ordering of industries starting with the largest by value of annual output.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List key industries by annual output value in descending order.

rubrics_metrics.name: Infant mortality rate
rubrics_metrics.description: This entry gives the number of deaths of infants under one year old in a given year per 1,000 live births in the same year; included is the total death rate, and deaths by sex. This rate is often used as an indicator of the level of health in a country.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Present infant deaths per 1,000 live births; include total and sex-disaggregated rates and note its use as a health indicator.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inflation rate (consumer prices)
rubrics_metrics.description: This entry furnishes the annual percent change in consumer prices compared with the previous year's consumer prices.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report annual consumer price inflation (percent) and specify base/reference period.

rubrics_metrics.name: Internet country code
rubrics_metrics.description: This entry includes the two-letter codes maintained by ISO in the ISO 3166 Alpha-2 list and used by IANA to establish country-coded top-level domains (ccTLDs).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide the ISO 3166 Alpha-2 two-letter code and note its use as the ccTLD identifier.

rubrics_metrics.name: Internet hosts
rubrics_metrics.description: This entry lists the number of Internet hosts available within a country. An Internet host is a computer connected directly to the Internet; the number of hosts is one indicator of the extent of Internet connectivity.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report number of hosts and, if relevant, note indicators of connectivity and definition of host.

rubrics_metrics.name: Internet users
rubrics_metrics.description: This entry gives the number of users within a country that access the Internet. Statistics vary and may include users who access the Internet at least several times a week to those who access it only once within a period of several months.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specify definition and frequency threshold used for counting 'users' to clarify comparability.

rubrics_metrics.name: International organization participation
rubrics_metrics.description: This entry lists in alphabetical order by abbreviation those international organizations in which the subject country is a member or participates in some other way.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List organizations alphabetically by abbreviation and indicate type/level of participation.

rubrics_metrics.name: International organizations (Appendix B)
rubrics_metrics.description: Appendix B includes the name, abbreviation, date established, aim, and members by category for international organizations and groups.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When referring to Appendix B, include full metadata: name, abbreviation, founding date, aims, and membership categories.

rubrics_metrics.name: Introduction / Background
rubrics_metrics.description: This category includes one entry, Background.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide a Background section introducing the country profile's context.

rubrics_metrics.name: Investment (gross fixed)
rubrics_metrics.description: This entry records total business spending on fixed assets, such as factories, machinery, equipment, dwellings, and inventories of raw materials, measured gross of depreciation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report gross fixed investment totals and clarify that figures are gross of depreciation and what asset types are included.

rubrics_metrics.name: Irrigated land
rubrics_metrics.description: This entry gives the number of square kilometers of land area that is artificially supplied with water.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report irrigated land area (sq km) and specify measurement date.

rubrics_metrics.name: Judicial branch
rubrics_metrics.description: This entry contains the name(s) of the highest court(s) and a brief description of the selection process for members.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List highest court(s) by name and briefly explain judicial selection/appointment procedures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Labor force (total)
rubrics_metrics.description: This entry contains the total labor force figure.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report total labor force number and indicate methodology/date.

rubrics_metrics.name: Labor force - by occupation
rubrics_metrics.description: This entry contains a rank ordering of component parts of the labor force by occupation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Break down labor force by occupation categories and rank by size/importance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Land boundaries
rubrics_metrics.description: This entry contains the total length of all land boundaries and the individual lengths for each of the contiguous border countries.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide total land boundary length and list individual border lengths by neighboring country.

rubrics_metrics.name: Land use (shares and definitions)
rubrics_metrics.description: This entry contains the percentage shares of total land area for three different types of land use: arable land, permanent crops, and other. Definitions of each type are provided (e.g., arable land is replanted after each harvest; permanent crops not replanted, includes flowering shrubs, fruit trees, vines; other includes meadows, forests, built-on areas, barren land, etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report percentage shares for arable, permanent crops, and other; use provided definitions to classify land.

rubrics_metrics.name: Languages
rubrics_metrics.description: This entry provides a rank ordering of languages starting with the largest and sometimes includes the percent of total population speaking that language.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List languages in descending order of speakers and include percent of population when available.

rubrics_metrics.name: Legal system
rubrics_metrics.description: This entry contains a brief description of the legal system's historical roots, role in government, and acceptance of International Court of Justice (ICJ) jurisdiction.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Summarize legal tradition, role of law in governance, and whether ICJ jurisdiction is accepted.

rubrics_metrics.name: Legislative branch
rubrics_metrics.description: This entry contains information on the structure (unicameral, bicameral, tricameral), formal name, number of seats, and term of office. Elections includes the nature of election process or accession to power, date of the last election, and date of the next election. Election results includes the percent of vote and/or number of seats held by each party in the last election.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe legislature structure/name, seat count, terms; summarize election method/dates and provide last-results vote percentages or seat counts by party.

rubrics_metrics.name: Life expectancy at birth
rubrics_metrics.description: This entry contains the average number of years to be lived by a group of people born in the same year, if mortality at each age remains constant in the future. Includes total population as well as male and female components.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide life expectancy at birth (total and by sex) and note its use as an overall quality-of-life indicator.

rubrics_metrics.name: Literacy
rubrics_metrics.description: This entry includes a definition of literacy and Census Bureau percentages for the total population, males, and females. There are no universal definitions and standards of literacy; unless otherwise specified, rates are based on the most common definition - the ability to read and write at a specified age.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report literacy percentages (total, male, female), state the definition used, and caution about cross-country comparability due to differing national standards.

rubrics_metrics.name: Location
rubrics_metrics.description: This entry identifies the country's regional location, neighboring countries, and adjacent bodies of water.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe regional placement, list neighbors and nearby bodies of water to situate the country geographically.

rubrics_metrics.name: Map references
rubrics_metrics.description: This entry includes the name of the Factbook reference map on which a country may be found. The entry on Geographic coordinates may be helpful in finding some smaller countries.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide the reference map name and optionally geographic coordinates to help locate the country on maps.

rubrics_metrics.name: Maritime claims (UNCLOS-based definitions)
rubrics_metrics.description: This entry includes maritime claims with UNCLOS-excerpted definitions: territorial sea (sovereignty up to 12 nm; baseline measurement notes), contiguous zone (control up to 24 nm to prevent/punish certain infringements), exclusive economic zone (EEZ) (sovereign rights for exploration/exploitation, conservation and other economic activities up to 200 nm), continental shelf (seabed/subsoil up to 200 nm or to natural prolongation limits with procedures for extension to 350 nm/100 nm from 2500m isobath), and exclusive fishing zone (used by some states instead of EEZ).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report claimed maritime zones and, where relevant, reference UNCLOS definitions and limits; specify exact breadths claimed and legal basis.

rubrics_metrics.name: Median age
rubrics_metrics.description: This entry is the age that divides a population into two numerically equal groups. It summarizes the age distribution and has implications for economic and social factors.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide median age and discuss its implications relative to age structure (young vs older populations).

rubrics_metrics.name: Merchant marine (four fields)
rubrics_metrics.description: Merchant marine may be defined as all ships engaged in the carriage of goods or all commercial vessels. This entry contains information in four fields - total, ships by type, foreign-owned, and registered in other countries. Total includes the number of ships (1,000 GRT or over), total DWT for those ships, and total GRT for those ships. DWT (dead weight tonnage) is defined.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report merchant marine with four fields: total (count, DWT, GRT), breakdown by ship type, foreign ownership, and those registered elsewhere; use thresholds (e.g., 1,000 GRT) and define DWT/GRT.

rubrics_metrics.name: Government type (definitions and classification)
rubrics_metrics.description: This entry gives the basic form of government and provides definitions of major governmental terms (e.g., Anarchy, Commonwealth, Communism, Confederacy, Constitutional, Constitutional Democracy, Constitutional Monarchy, Democracy, Democratic Republic, Dictatorship, Ecclesiastical, Federal, Federal Republic, Maoism, Marxism, Marxism-Leninism, Monarchy, Oligarchy, Parliamentary Democracy, Parliamentary Government, Parliamentary Monarchy, Republic, Socialism, Sultanate, Theocracy, Totalitarian).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Classify a country's government using the provided definitions and choose the basic form that best fits the nation's institutions and practices.

rubrics_metrics.name: Government - note
rubrics_metrics.description: This entry includes miscellaneous government information of significance not included elsewhere.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use for notable government details that do not fit standard government subfields.
